Positive Aspects :

1. 24 hours electricity (even during major power cuts in the city)
2. 24 hours water /Geyser facility /Washing Machine.
3. Variety of South Indian Food in Meals (3 times a day, Lunch comes early morning along with Breakfast, so that whoever has to go office, can pack it and go)
4. My room had a balcony so I kept my plants there, dried lingeries, washed plates.
5. This area is peaceful, no noise during night hours .
6. You can Cook for yourself, kitchen is all yours, fridge is also available (its a good thing for mid night cravings)
7. You can chill in Hall and entrance area (half in shed of tree)
8. At 10 O'Clock the watchman locks the main gate, but you can have the Keys and come anytime, there's no restrictions.
9. Can go for Morning/evening/night walk, as the area is peaceful. (Else you can go to Narella Park just Beside the PG, 300 mt.s away. I could not avail this benefit because I stayed during covid period, park is still close for safety purpose)
10. If your office is nearby , you can walk down, I used to go walking as my office was just 950 Mts. away from PG.
11. Its NOT in a remote area, everything is close by, nearest mall is 500mts. away- Sarath City, nearest metro is Hitech City, cycling park is also nearby.
12. Reasonably  OK WiFi facility -24 hours.
13. The person who brings food/drinking water is really humble person, though he only speaks Telgu, but tries to communicate as much as he can.
14. I am grateful that the PG owner didn't take any advances/security deposits from me, as I informed him , I will only stay for One month. And also provided me one separate Cupboard.

Negative Aspects :

1. I am hygiene freak, I left this PG because they used to clean it once a week or once in 2 weeks, that too after constant reminders (PG owner used to say, workers are not available due to covid, which is indigestible excuse to me)
2.  I didn't know if finding a humble, kind, polite, understanding PG owner is also an important thing, so be cautious.
3. Before joining, the owner took a ₹3,000 advance deposit and explicitly promised it would be fully refundable upon leaving. Even though I fulfilled all their notice period criteria and followed every single rule, the owner flat-out refused to return my advance. Dealing with this kind of dishonesty is incredibly frustrating and unprofessional.
2. Overpriced for What They Offer
They charge ₹12,000 (or more) for a 2-sharing room. Frankly, it is not worth it at all. For ₹11,500, you can easily find a much better room with an AC in prime, fully developed areas.
3. Terrible Location (Isolated & Under Construction)
The PG is located in an isolated area surrounded by ongoing construction, meaning you will deal with constant dust and noise. There isn't a single basic shop nearby. If you want a better lifestyle, look at main areas like Gowlidoddy, which are lively, crowded with markets, and have every shop you need within walking distance.

Residents are limited to approximately 105 GB of Wi-Fi data per month, which is insufficient for people working from home and gets exhausted quickly. Considering the high rent being charged, the absence of unlimited internet is difficult to justify.

Overall, the experience has been stressful and frustrating.
